rule: R2-DEC-031: frozen before any M10 measurement; every measured row PARITY or IMPROVED in all eight dimensions, or wholly EXCLUDED with an intentional difference

donor.runtime_identity: CPython 3.13 executing the exact pinned function sources from donor_functions.json against /usr/bin/ffprobe and /usr/bin/ffmpeg; template window [1, 10] s

dimension_criteria.functionality: M10 detects every condition the donor detects on the same fixture
dimension_criteria.correctness: M10 outcome matches the fixture ground truth; IMPROVED where the donor is wrong on a defect fixture
dimension_criteria.determinism: two M10 runs on one fixture give equal measurement_digest (IMPROVED: digest-bound) or, for pure rules, equal outputs (PARITY)
dimension_criteria.failure_safety: on defect fixtures M10 never yields a passing outcome where the donor silently passes or crashes untyped (IMPROVED); PARITY where both refuse
dimension_criteria.data_integrity: M10 binds the measured input content digest (IMPROVED over path-only donor); PARITY for pure rules over identical inputs
dimension_criteria.observability: M10 returns typed status/codes (IMPROVED over free text); PARITY when both are typed
dimension_criteria.performance: PARITY iff M10 median wall time <= donor median + 1500 ms and within the config max_runtime_ms; never IMPROVED
dimension_criteria.resources: IMPROVED iff M10 runs under declared runtime/output ceilings with ResourceEvidence; donor subprocess is unbounded; PARITY for pure rules

criteria.m10: changed/missing master is refused with M10_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_MISSING before any probe subprocess
LOUDNESS INTEGRATED_LUFS [-35,-8], REQUIRED applicability; SILENT is FAIL, explicit SILENT_AUDIO_INAPPLICABLE is INAPPLICABLE
CAPTIONS coverage ratio >= 0.6; donor passes any single word timing and skips a missing audio.json; M10 refuses missing caption evidence typed
missing/failed/indeterminate slots are unmet: PASS refused, readiness NOT_READY
truncated/unqualified media is M10_PROBE_FAILED; donor raises untyped ValueError or misreports

rows.intentional_difference: Template duration window is a platform/format constraint owned by the M10-B typed platform-constraint profile amendment (2026-09-16 spec §7); M10-A records exact container duration facts. Carried to M10-B.
Metadata lint is packaging, owned by M10-B.
Self-scored virality is rejected as quality authority (2026-09-16 spec §2: no self-score).
Automatic AI repair requires a remote provider and self-approves; M10-A exposes REWORK repair routing only, with no mutation port.

not_claimed: volumedetect regex-miss silent pass: no admissible fixture produced it; not a row
notes: Donor run() executes every gate with no short-circuit beyond the missing-file prerequisite, so cost ordering beyond missing_master is not a donor behavior to match.
